rightsNote:
Everything in this knowledge base is written by icanspeak Italian and generated from this site's own data. None of it is scanned, copied or taken in part from a coursebook — that is exactly why we can give it away. Every file says at the bottom where it comes from.

What is deliberately NOT here: audio and book files from publishers and exam bodies (coursebooks, CILS, CELI, PLIDA or CERT.IT sample papers and preparation books). We are not allowed to pass those on, not even for free and not even in class. Instead, we link to the official pages of the exam bodies and dictionaries — see “Official materials”. icanspeak Italian is not affiliated with the Università per Stranieri di Siena, the Università per Stranieri di Perugia, the Società Dante Alighieri or Roma Tre University.
